units.source_text: 中将辞了小野草庵，便上山去访问僧都。

en.t: The Captain took leave of the hermitage at Ono and went up the mountain to visit the bishop.

units.source_text: 僧都奉他为稀客，和他畅谈世事。

en.t: The bishop received him as a rare guest and talked with him at length about the affairs of the world.

units.source_text: 这天晚上他就在那里宿夜，请几位声音庄严的法师诵经，

en.t: That evening he stayed there for the night and asked several priests with solemn voices to chant sutras,

units.source_text: 又共奏弦管，直至天明。

en.t: and they also played string and wind instruments together until daybreak.

units.source_text: 他和那个当禅师的弟弟详细谈论种种事情，便中说道：

en.t: He spoke in detail about many matters with his younger brother, who had become a Zen master, and in the course of the conversation said:

units.source_text: “此次途经小野，曾赴草庵访问，心中无限感慨。

en.t: This time, as I was passing through Ono, I visited the hermitage, and my heart was filled with endless feeling.

units.source_text: 出家离世之人，犹有这等风雅情怀，真是难得的啊！”

en.t: For people who have left the world and taken religious vows to still possess such refined sensibility is truly rare.

units.source_text: 后来又说：

en.t: Later he added:

units.source_text: “那时刮起一阵风来，把帘子吹开，我从帘隙窥见一个长发美人。

en.t: At that moment a gust of wind rose and blew the curtain open, and through the gap I glimpsed a beautiful woman with long hair.

units.source_text: 大概她怕外面有人看见吧，立刻回身入内，

en.t: Perhaps she feared someone outside might see her, for she immediately turned back and went inside,

units.source_text: 照那后影看来，决不是一个普通侍女。

en.t: and judging from her figure from behind, she was certainly no ordinary maidservant.

units.source_text: 这等地方养着美貌女郎，很不相宜。

en.t: It is quite unsuitable to keep such a beautiful young woman in a place like that.

units.source_text: 她朝夕见惯的都是尼僧，久后自然和她们同化，

en.t: Morning and evening she sees only nuns, and in time she will naturally become like them,

units.source_text: 这实在是不好的事。”

en.t: which is truly not a good thing.

units.source_text: 禅师答道：

en.t: The Zen master replied:

units.source_text: “听说这人是她们今春赴初濑进香时由于某种奇缘而找到的。”

en.t: I hear that they found this person through some strange bond when they went on pilgrimage to Hatsuse this spring.

units.source_text: 这禅师并未亲自目击此事，所以不能详述情状。

en.t: This Zen master had not witnessed the matter himself, so he could not describe the circumstances in detail.

units.source_text: 中将说道：

en.t: The Captain said:

units.source_text: “这真是可悲的事。

en.t: That is truly a sad thing.

units.source_text: 不知她是怎样的一个人。

en.t: I wonder what sort of person she is.

units.source_text: 想必是身逢忧患，心怀厌世，

en.t: She must have met with sorrow and misfortune and grown weary of the world,

units.source_text: 因而隐身在那荒僻之处的吧。

en.t: and for that reason hidden herself away in that desolate place.

units.source_text: 倒很像是古代小说中的人物呢。”

en.t: She really seems like a character from an old tale.
